verdict.rationale: Snowsight's Query History page lets users monitor individual or grouped queries over the last 14 days, and the docs say you can explore each step of an executed query in the query profile. Together these cover the core of finding why a query is slow. missing for 10: documented EXPLAIN or pre-execution plan inspection, per-query cost or credit attribution in the profile, detail on profile operator statistics (e.g. pruning or spilling), and independent hands-on corroboration of using the profile for diagnosis.
